sources: sec edgar submissions api, 8-K item 2.02 acceptance times

history.basis: 6-K exhibit text matched results language (16 filings opened). Heuristic, not an item code: a 6-K carrying results language is very likely an earnings release but this is weaker than the 8-K item 2.02 path

event_plausibility.reason: DOWNGRADE -- the other symmetric half. 'fits_cadence' rests on a 77-day median gap in 6-K text matches, but the only evidence for a 2026-09-03 print is the calendar row itself. Amber has always pre-announced by 6-K (the 2026-05-21 6-K set the 2026-05-28 Q1 call), and every 6-K on CIK 0001697818 since July -- 2026-07-28, 2026-08-10 (leadership changes) and 2026-08-31 (the AMBR agentic-AI rebrand) -- contains no results date, with the supposed print one day away. Last year's comparable half-year report landed 2025-09-10, a week later than the calendar's date. Not set to 'suspect', which would bar the name from ranking on absence of evidence alone; 'unknown' states exactly what is known, which is that the event is unestablished.

amended_from.reason: 98 days since the last print against a 77-day cadence

event_plausibility.amended_by: edge sweep, company-sourced; before any hunter launched

options.event_implied_move_basis: straddle taken as-is (no vol anchor to net off)
options.skew_note: IV(25d put) - IV(25d call). Positive = the market is paying more for downside protection than for upside.
warnings: ATM legs not two-sided; no live bid/ask to price a straddle from

deadband_basis: half the median of 4 prior reactions, floored at 1.5%
deadband_note: A realised move inside this band is scored as no-direction rather than as a miss.
expected_move_basis: median historical reaction (no usable option chain)

baseline_quality.note: thin means there is no reliable statement of what the market priced, so a confident call on this name cannot be justified by the baseline.
